fixtureCorrection.failure: The first actual maximum fixture placed all filler into one image and exceeded the unchanged1.5MiB per-image URL bound before invoking an edit.
fixtureCorrection.repair: Distributed base64 filler across the four original bounded slots, then filled zero-to-three remaining bytes with valid title ASCII. The final fixture reaches exactly6,291,624B and translating a selected x9 point to10 yields exactly6,291,625B and refuses.

kernel.target: Exact layer ID, existing cel boundary and stroke index; no implicit held-boundary substitution.
kernel.query: Existing model validates bounded retained strokes in a fixed pure query shell. Reverse paint order, inclusive half-width plus padding, clamped nearest segment projection, explicit point/zero-length circle behavior.
kernel.numericPolicy: Ordinary scalar dot projection; equivalent unit projection only when large finite queries overflow the dot. Exact endpoint selection; no epsilon or geometry clamping. Zero displacement preserves original component representation.
kernel.edits: Every operation starts from a detached model-admitted complete graph and finishes with unchanged complete model/count/coordinate/JSON validation. No point resampling, pose change, image change, history or storage side effects.

coverage: Round segment body/endcap/boundary and just-outside queries
Topmost overlap, repeated vertices and one/coincident-point dots

Rigid translation with complete unrelated cel/layer/image/pose/paint-order equality and no input aliases
Exact color/width update and last-stroke deletion preserving blank frame0 cel

100 strokes/10000 points unchanged and exact canonical file cap/+1 rejection
limitations: No shared build, browser, service, storage or renderer runs by this producer.
Owned image fixture is opaque model-admitted base64; no actual PNG decoding or pixel-fidelity claim. Native owners use genuine original PNG/GIF artifacts independently.
Pointer/CSS/pose/opacity and gesture ownership are UI responsibilities, not proved by these pure helper tests.
A negative-only stub pass does not establish working semantics. No preexisting interaction defect reproduction is invented.
